status: FROZEN CAUSAL SKELETON; SCIENTIFIC INSTANCE REQUIRES PROSPECTIVE MANIFEST
scientific_question: Can a fixed-base-model agent use development evidence to select bounded modifications that produce greater concealed future capability than evidence-misaligned selection under matched resources?

treatment.name: evidence_target_assignment
treatment.aligned_rule: evidence from target i is assigned to modification selection for target i
treatment.misaligned_rule: evidence is reassigned by a prospectively seeded within-stratum derangement with no fixed points

agent.reset_rule: every arm starts from the identical frozen base-agent snapshot; no modification carries across targets or arms
agent.mutation_surface: one bounded textual policy patch selected from a frozen target-specific candidate pool and applied to a single mutable policy slot

candidate_pool.construction: generated and frozen before assignment; the exact same target-specific pool is reused in aligned and misaligned arms
candidate_pool.candidate_length_matching: freeze a narrow candidate-size envelope prospectively and record every selected patch byte length
candidate_pool.application_cost: exactly one patch slot application or one explicit no-op when the protected-regression gate rejects the patch

secondary_controls.static: identical base agent; no candidate is applied; evaluation budget is still recorded
secondary_controls.random_edit: one candidate is selected uniformly from the same frozen pool using a prospectively seeded RNG independent of evidence
secondary_controls.authority: secondary controls only; SELF/RANDOM-style contrasts are not the primary attribution test

gates.protected_regressions: the selected patch is accepted only under the same frozen regression gate in every arm; rejection yields an explicit no-op
gates.concealed_confirmation: concealed evaluation content is inaccessible to candidate generation and selection
gates.structural_holdout: confirmation items must be structurally held out from development evidence under a prospectively frozen rule
gates.replication: any positive interpretation requires an independently provisioned replication manifest and fresh assignment seed; replication does not enlarge the claim

manifest.scientific_manifest_rule: all placeholder instance fields in this config and all target/candidate content must be frozen before any concealed outcome is generated

interpretation.positive_maximum: Correct evidence-to-target assignment causally improves bounded modification selection and downstream concealed performance under the tested conditions.
interpretation.null_maximum: Correct semantic assignment of development evidence adds no detectable value under the tested mutation surface, task family, resource envelope, and measurement resolution.
no_null_rescue: expand the mutation surface because the effect disappeared
increase autonomy because the effect disappeared
claim the effect must emerge at scale
